## Task
1. Find which of: (a) a redirect or sub-frame to a host not in `broker.domains` raising `BlockedByPolicy` (`src/freemyid/engine/browser.py`, `check_escaped`/`goto`), (b) `--host-resolver-rules` making the first navigation fail, (c) the Edge channel launch with these args failing on Windows, (d) something else, closes the window. Use fixture servers and the registry entries for web-form brokers; check each web-form broker's opt-out URL redirect chain against its domains (offline, from registry data; live checks only through the existing allowed tooling).
2. Never close the window silently. When the window must stop, show the person a plain message in the app ("This site sent us to an address we don't recognise, so we stopped. You can finish this one in your normal browser.") with an "Open in my browser" action, and keep the to-do card.
3. Fix the registry data or redirect handling so normal same-company redirects (www., trailing locale, the broker's own opt-out portal listed with a source) are allowed.
4. Log the reason code only (no URL, no values), as today.

## Acceptance
- A regression test per root cause found (fixture redirect to www., to an unlisted host).
- A registry health check flags web-form brokers whose opt-out URL host is not in their domains.
- Full test, ruff, mypy pass; qa-security review of any allowlist change.
